name: validation_steps
title: Validation objective across training steps
description: Measured validation checkpoints; no interpolation, smoothing, confidence interval or final-test evaluation. Missing fits stay blank.

name: validation_cumulative_steps
title: Validation objective across inherited lineage steps
description: Measured validation checkpoints; no interpolation, smoothing, confidence interval or final-test evaluation. Missing fits stay blank.

name: hungarian_regret
title: Gap to Hungarian on the same validation cohort
description: Measured validation checkpoints; no interpolation, smoothing, confidence interval or final-test evaluation. Missing fits stay blank.

name: training_return
title: Training episode return per student — rolling last 100 completed episodes
description: Mean of the latest 100 completed training episodes (all completed if fewer), normalized by train cohort size. Reward includes completion bonus and shaping; it is not the validation objective or a causal cross-cohort comparison.

name: training_loss
title: Training loss by learner and fit
description: Raw loss values with deterministic display subsampling for dense logs; no smoothing. PPO and DQN losses use separate axes and are not directly comparable.

name: final_comparison
title: Final validation comparison
description: Candidate point estimates and classical baselines on the same cohort; accepted is a research gate, not superiority to Hungarian. No cross-semester raw-score ranking.

name: forgetting_heatmap
title: Frozen historical holdout forgetting
description: Signed objective drop on exact frozen prior validation cohorts. Red positive is degradation; blue negative is improvement. Missing observations remain masked.

name: runtime_constraints
title: Runtime and feasibility
description: Elapsed time is measured wall time from the run; coverage and constraint counts are final validation quantities, not academic quality.

name: smoke_vs_long
title: Smoke and long-budget validation results
description: Budget comparison also changes inherited parent trajectory; it is not an isolated causal effect of extra steps. One seed, no confidence interval.

name: final_test_comparison
title: One-time final-test comparison after frozen selection
description: Selected/retained, final warm candidates and from-scratch controls were fixed before the final test was opened. Duplicate checkpoints can appear under different roles but reuse cached evaluation; bars are not independent samples. Final test is absent from training curves and model selection. One seed and small n; no confidence interval or academic-effectiveness claim.
